inventory_scope: canonical release certificate plus historical process archive

canonical_release_result.arithmetic: exact rational with input denominators at most 100

release_artifacts.role: fail-closed exact replay, KKT, Lyapunov, and support-radius verifier

curated_process_archive.scope: Sanitized isolated-workspace snapshot containing the starting contract, research log, theory notes, experiment and test scripts, saved JSON and NPZ results, literature notes, and terminal report.

counting_notes: The scans are successive or nested route records and must not be summed into a single trial count.
Saved sequences and files are not theorem counts.
Recorded route timing is not a timing claim for regenerating the canonical release certificate.

excluded: raw chat logs and session exports
